Unit_Human_Desc: A versatile and resilient warrior skilled in both melee and ranged combat. Humans adapt quickly to various battle conditions.
Unit_Goblin_Desc: Small and cunning creatures known for their speed and trickery. Goblins excel in ambush tactics and hit-and-run attacks.
Unit_Orc_Desc: Powerful and brutal fighters with immense physical strength. Orcs rely on overwhelming force and savage melee combat.
Unit_Troll_Desc: Large and durable creatures with regenerative abilities. Trolls endure heavy damage and retaliate fiercely in battle.
Unit_Skeleton_Desc: Undead warriors animated by dark magic. Skeletons are relentless but fragile, often attacking in large numbers.
